decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint fits the core water-pipeline fitting business and uses existing welding and coating capabilities, so it likely meets aspirations at low marginal cost and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The pipe bracket is a simple extension of the established offer and cheap to carry, and although the similar Product C was withdrawn, B kept its own page and the growing industry provides slack to keep it.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core but reuses the coating equipment and sells to the same municipal customers, so with slack from industry growth management can carry it while its results are still uncertain.
The waste bin with ashtray is a multi-model line that shares production with D, and unclear results in a growing market do not fall far enough below aspiration to justify dropping it yet.

The outdoor ashtrays are the furthest from the pipeline core and the most exposed if street-furniture sales disappoint, but they share coating resources and municipal channels with D and E, so they are kept for now despite the higher risk.
